# AI Learner MCQ - Professional MCQ Generator

This is a professional MCQ (Multiple Choice Questions) generator application built with:

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
- **Backend**: FastAPI with Python
- **AI**: Google Gemini AI integration
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
- **Authentication**: NextAuth.js
- **Deployment**: Docker ready

## Architecture
- Modern full-stack application with separation of concerns
- RESTful API design
- Component-based UI with reusable components
- Type-safe development with TypeScript
- Responsive design with Tailwind CSS
- Professional UI/UX patterns

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all frontend code
- Follow Next.js 14 App Router patterns
- Use shadcn/ui components for consistent UI
- Implement proper error handling and loading states
- Use React hooks and modern React patterns
- Follow REST API conventions for backend
- Implement proper validation and sanitization
- Use environment variables for sensitive data
- Follow security best practices
